{{Quote|From the Battles of Rashfond, to the Peacekeeping of Parliock, to our very own Clone Wars, the lightsaber is a Jedi's only true ally.|[[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]], to a class of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]]|<ref name="ATOS" />}}
The '''Battles of Rashfond''' were a series of battles that were fought at some point before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which involved the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Professor/Legends|professor]] [[Huyang/Legends|Huyang]] recalled the Battles of Rashfond while telling a class of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] about conflicts the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had been involved in. The [[Architect droid/Legends|architect droid]] mentioned the event while instructing the [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]] in the construction of their own [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].<ref name="ATOS" />
